title: Final answer audit of MPPSC 2022 Prelims Paper-I

summary.method: Every one of the 100 questions was re-read and answered independently; the printed key was compared with the stored answer; each explanation was rebuilt to a four-part standard (concept and justification, per-option reasoning tied to that option text, revision facts, takeaway). A correction is recorded only where the evidence contradicts the key and another option is demonstrably right; an item whose options cannot express the historically correct answer is flagged ambiguous rather than forced. Scan damage in option text was repaired only where the printed paper makes the intended wording certain.
